lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Five vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. The spots are arranged in roughly horizontal rows, creating a multi-tiered spatial grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a distinct grid of anchor nodes. These intersections are most pronounced in the central region between the pectoral fin and the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light-colored upper edge and a dark, shadow-defined lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of approximately 8 to 10 identifiable high-luminance spots of varying diameters, irregularly spaced within the visible silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin displays a dense, randomized distribution of small, high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter compared to the primary blobs on the lateral flank.
